evidence.excerpt: This study was conducted in January 2025 using leading international databases, namely Scopus, Science Direct, and Emerald, with the keywords (“disaster preparedness” OR “disaster risk resilience” OR “disaster risk reduction”) AND (“elementary school” OR “primary school”) AND (“model” OR “framework” OR “program”) AND (“strategy” OR “implementation” OR ‘practice’ OR “policy”). After entering the keywords into the database, the researcher recorded the total number of articles. The screening stage involved identifying and removing duplicate articles using Zotero software. Screening was conducted based on the title and abstract according to the inclusion criterias.

assessment.rationale: The document describes a database search and screening of articles using defined keywords, duplicate removal, and title/abstract inclusion screening, which directly indicates a literature-review process rather than a single primary empirical study.
